before.mode: Raw SHA-256 for every inventory file plus scripts/snapshot.mjs aggregate

after.mode: Raw SHA-256 for every inventory file plus scripts/snapshot.mjs aggregate

executionRestrictions: No source changes, historical source access, WORKLOG reads, full-suite execution, real provider API calls, credential reads, personal CODEX_HOME reads or live-host service changes.

This reviewer did not execute deployment tests, Go compilation, Linux root/systemd probes or browser/public-certificate acceptance. The review is static semantic inspection plus local inventory and lock-record checks.
Windows host cannot establish Linux UID, namespace, cgroup or mount lifecycle behavior by static review. No request was made to use 192.168.1.120.
Third-party package source code and authenticated module-download provenance were outside this reviewer execution; complete Go lock parsing does not prove external module integrity.
independenceLimitations: While locating the report helper, the reviewer accidentally opened .work/builtin-tooling-report.mjs, an older report generator containing a zero-findings declaration and review method. No historical report JSON, WORKLOG, old source or git history was opened. Its conclusions were not used; nevertheless, the no-history independence requirement is compromised, so this report explicitly cannot establish a clean independent audit round.

The parent supplied a narrow current-run DNS build failure observation for independent checking. This was used solely to select code boundaries for review; the parent fixture outputs were not opened and are not represented as this reviewer execution evidence.

checks.name: Go lock full record structure and require coverage
Deployment dynamic tests
checks.reason: Read-only audit; no specific new product defect required reproduction.

methodDetails.review: Fresh current-source semantic audit of all deployment implementation, Go entrypoint/tests, installation shell, README and recovery runbook, every ordinary/root deployment test and all four explicit acceptance probes. Read complete text in bounded nontruncated chunks; revisited output gaps. Traced admission, permissions, credentials, service state, cgroup stop proofs, durable journals, failure and recovery paths, workspace/Git operations, quotas, network isolation, HTTPS migration and six DNS provider mappings against their test assertions and documented operator contract.
methodDetails.dataReview: go.sum was interpreted as all 1545 lock records across 625 modules: every complete record parsed, canonical 32-byte h1 base64 and module-version uniqueness checked, all module paths and versions manually reviewed in three exhaustive grouped batches. All 193 go.mod require entries have both module archive and go.mod checksum entries. Opaque digest strings were validated by parser rather than manually transcribed; no external checksum database or dependency source provenance verification was performed.
methodDetails.dnsFailureAssessment: Reviewed provision_dns_caddy failure boundaries and compared Builder.prepare with RECOVERY.md and README. Retention of bounded failed workspaces is explicitly documented and is not itself a confirmed cleanup defect. Did not treat parent-provided SSH test-helper failure reports as independent product evidence.
methodDetails.coverage: 113 of 113 deployment inventory files inspected; 4 current tooling files additionally inspected. The 63-file tooling_docs group was separately assigned by the parent and is not claimed here.
